Clear local payment steps

The plan price shown above is the amount to send in ETB.

  1. 1. Send the exact plan amount to one of the listed Telebirr or bank accounts.
  2. 2. Submit your payment receipt screenshot for verification.
  3. 3. Minutes and credits are added after the payment is verified by the Bgern team.

Refunds may be requested within 15 days of purchase only while the package is completely unused. Once any minutes or credits have been used, the package is non-refundable. Unused balances do not roll over to future purchases. Contact Bgern support with payment or refund questions.
